title: Custom Clothing from Reference Images | LF Clothing
heading: How to start custom clothing from a reference image
description: No complete tech pack? Learn what to send, how to describe changes and what to approve before LF Clothing develops your custom garment.
intro: A reference image can start a custom clothing project. You do not need a complete tech pack to make the first inquiry: explain the intended use, quantities and the details you want to keep or change.

sections.heading: Explain what the image means to you
sections.text: Identify the shape, pockets, collar, colours and fit you like. Mark changes on the image or list them separately. A photograph cannot confirm fabric composition, weight or hidden construction; send a physical garment if these details are important.

sections.heading: Add the practical requirements
sections.text: Include the garment type, quantity per style and colour, wearer size range, logo artwork, delivery country and required arrival date. Tell us your target budget and any fabric or performance requirements. Unknown details can be discussed during development.

sections.heading: Choose the development route
sections.text: Develop a different fabric, silhouette or functional construction. We work through the practical specification and sample with you.

sections.heading: Confirm the fabric and process proposal
sections.text: We first clarify how the garment will be used and any requirements for water resistance, breathability, texture and colour. We then select a suitable fabric and propose the matching construction, decoration and finishing methods. We send you the fabric choice and process proposal for confirmation before sampling.

sections.heading: Approve a sample before production
sections.text: Review the sample's fit, fabric feel, measurements, construction and branding. Record the changes and agree the production specification. Regular clothing usually starts at 50 pieces per style/colour; materials and customization can affect minimums. Sampling, production and shipping are scheduled for the order.
